PyP6 5.2.2 changes how releases are numbered and built. The app itself works exactly as in 5.2.1.

## What's different
- The version shown in the title bar and in **Settings → About** now comes straight from the release tag, so it can no longer disagree with the download you picked.
- Running from source, the script is now simply `PyP6-Roland-P6-Sample-Manager.py`, without a version in its name. From a git checkout, About shows the nearest release plus the commits since, e.g. `5.2.2-3-gabc1234`.

Everything else in 5.2 is unchanged: see the [5.2.0 notes](https://github.com/HomoHabilis/Roland-P6-files-manager/releases/tag/v5.2.0) for the pattern preview and the [5.2.1 notes](https://github.com/HomoHabilis/Roland-P6-files-manager/releases/tag/v5.2.1) for the live-recorded pattern fix.

## Upgrading
Nothing changes in presets or pattern files: everything saved by 5.2.1 loads in 5.2.2 as before.
